about: Independent, sourced audit of TWC 2026 day 2 results and day 3 coverage. This file records what was verifiable from frozen Hotspawn data and external sources; it does not create or backfill a pick. The capture is the 2026-10-15T21:34:12Z snapshot.

day2_matches.archive_status: No 1080201 entry in hotspawn/data/pick_history.json. valuepicks/data/coverage.csv independently records the fixture locked at 08:24Z with blank pick and probabilities. Do not grade or reconstruct a pick.

day2_matches.market_provenance_note: The frozen Hotspawn history retains the Pinnacle label and probability but not the exact price pair. valuepicks/data/coverage.csv separately archives a direct Pinnacle-derived 75.8%/24.2% line; its source fact F-21 records the quote and the initially disputed 30-minute kickoff offset, later checked against HLTV's 11:00Z listing.

The Hotspawn frozen record labels this probability Pinnacle but preserves no odds or quote URL. valuepicks/data/coverage.csv instead identifies a relayed BetBoom-book quote (cyber.sports.ru, 1.85/1.95) at 10:05Z and 51.3%/48.7%; do not present those as the same quote. Grade the frozen side, not an unretained market price.

The frozen Hotspawn history labels the basis Pinnacle but does not retain the exact quote. valuepicks/data/coverage.csv has a nearby 42.6%/57.4% primary-market estimate without naming the operator; treat it as a cross-check, not proof of the exact Hotspawn quote.

day2_grade.interpretation: Both strategies went 2/3 on the three frozen picks. The Aurora-NiP result is reported, but is not in either denominator because no frozen pick exists. Small sample; descriptive only.

aurora_vs_9z.ownership_rule: Hotspawn crowd shares are ownership only, never a win-probability input.

leaderboard_strategy.usage: Optional high-variance play only when intentionally chasing; Aurora remains the default / most-likely-side pick.

day2_context: On day 2, Aurora beat NiP 2-0 (Cache 13-9, Dust2 13-7): https://www.hltv.org/matches/2399408/aurora-vs-ninjas-in-pyjamas-thunderpick-world-championship-2026
On day 2, 9z lost 1-2 to Falcons but took Mirage 13-8 and lost Nuke and Dust2 9-13: https://www.hltv.org/matches/2399409/9z-vs-falcons-thunderpick-world-championship-2026

roster_context.moves: Jimpphat joined 2026-07-03; kyxsan joined 2026-07-08 as the new IGL. About three months before the decider, not a days-old change.
roster_context.current_hltv_read: The team page read on 2026-10-15 displayed Jimpphat at 103 days in the team and 61 maps. An earlier repository note recorded 104 days/62 maps; the page is dynamic and the fields are not a stable five-player total. Use the approximate three-month description, not an exact map count.
roster_context.recent_results: Aurora placed third at ESL Pro League Season 24 on 2026-10-11 and beat NIP on day 2 of TWC.
roster_context.weighting: Retain the existing moderate roster factor as a tiebreaker for the leaderboard rule only; it does not override the market or own-line probabilities, and the successful recent results argue against treating onboarding as a decisive negative.

other_price_checks.capture_status: No Pinnacle quote was joined to this fixture in the 21:34Z Hotspawn snapshot.
other_price_checks.use: Not used; do not infer a line from absence in this capture.

other_price_checks.limitation: The page does not identify the bookmaker; excluded from the probability calculation.

other_price_checks.page_display: Winline 1.46 for Aurora and Betcity 2.85 for 9z; editorial prose also quotes 1.38 / 2.70 without attributing it to one book.
other_price_checks.limitation: The displayed sportsbook prices are from different books and the editorial pair is unattributed; neither is a valid same-book two-way line to de-vig. Excluded.

betboom_vs_legacy.coverage_status: Not present in the 2026-10-15T21:34:12Z Hotspawn capture (88 fixtures, 22 open).
betboom_vs_legacy.publication_rule: Do not fabricate a Hotspawn fixture ID, pick, or win probabilities. Recheck after the next scheduled refresh; publish only if Hotspawn lists it.
betboom_vs_legacy.time_limit: HLTV's rendered 13:00 lacks a dependable timezone and Liquipedia's secondary listing says 19:00 CEST; do not publish an exact UTC start from these sources alone.

capture_irregularities.evidence: Both payload rows have the same competition ID (35859), teams and team IDs. 1080204 starts at 16:00Z and appears on lobby/cs2-pickems/thp-pickems with 33 total picks; 1081614 starts at 17:00Z, appears only on thp-pickems and has 0/0 ownership. HLTV has one Legacy-FURIA day-2 match page (2399411), which records the finished 2-1 series.
capture_irregularities.treatment: Keep both raw fixture rows for audit. Grade only the frozen pick on 1080204; do not create a second pick or second result for 1081614.
